# The retired spellings

Generated by `webc lint --rules` from the table `webc check` runs. A line in
the left column is a word an app may not name; the right column is what to write
instead. The gate reads code, tests and docs; a page exempted in `lint.exempt`
may name a spelling on purpose, because it is quoting it in order to forbid it.

| never write | what it is | write instead | scanned |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text_s(` | the str flavour of text | text("%s", s) | all |
| `wc_res_text(` | the body builder behind res_text | res_text(200, "...") | code |
| `wc_res_html(` | the body builder behind res_html | res_html(200, "...") | code |
| `res_json_raw(` | a JSON body from bytes | json(200, "{...}") | all |
| `res_json_str(` | a JSON body from a str | json(200, "{...}") | all |
| `json_str(` | a JSON body from a str | json(200, s) | all |
| `json_vec(` | a JSON array that needed its type spelled | json_list(200, rows) | all |
| `json_error(` | an error body | res_error(404, "not_found", "...") | all |
| `head_html(fmt("<script` | a <script> body built by hand | head_ld(ld_blog_posting(...)) | all |
| `res_ssr(` | the long render call | page(View, ctx) | all |
| `res_page(` | the long render call | page(View, ctx) | all |
| `res_page_auto(` | the long render call | page(View, ctx) | all |
| `view_as(` | a second way to name a view | declare_view(Name, Ctx); + view(Name, Ctx *c) | all |
| `VIEW_CTX(` | a second way to declare a view | declare_view(Name, Ctx) | all |
| `mount_ctx(` | a second way to mount | mount(View, ctx, "#root") | all |
| `raw(` | a second name for authored markup | markup("<svg ...>") | all |
| `respond_model(` | the four-way response macro | (wc_body_is_form() ? redirect("/") : json(200, T, p)) | all |
| `WEBC_VEC_DEFINE` | a hand-named vector | Vec(T) | all |
| `WEBC_VEC_DECLARE` | a hand-named vector | Vec(T) | all |
| `webc/webc.h` | the do-everything include | <webc/server.h> or <webc/frontend.h> | all |
| `(void)(ctx);` | an ignored parameter | write the signature the view needs | all |
| `wc_bind_hook(` | wiring an action by name | on_click(action_name) | all |
| `wc_bind_str(` | wiring an input by name | bind(sig) | all |
| `wc_hook(` | registering a name for wires.h | on_click(action_name) | all |
| `wc_input_hook(` | registering an input name | bind(sig) | all |
| `webc wires` | the wiring codegen step | nothing: wiring is a symbol now | docs |
| `signal_str(` | the str flavour of a signal | state(Text, name, "") | all |
| `w_state_register(` | the state registry by hand | state(...) | all |
| `str_fmt(` | formatting into a str | fmt() | all |
| `str_cstr(` | turning a str into a char* | Text is already char* | all |
| `str_dup(` | copying into an arena | text_copy(), persist() | all |
| `arena_alloc(` | allocating by hand | fmt(), text_copy(), persist() | all |
| `arena_new` | an arena in app code | nothing: the scope arena is installed | all |
| `wc_arena_get` | asking which arena is current | fmt(), text_copy(), persist() | all |
| `__wasm__` | a target test in app code | list the file under "client" | all |
| `export_name` | the wasm export protocol | nothing: the framework exports | all |
| `wc_app_main` | the wasm entry point | client_main { ... } | all |
| `webc_data` | the hydration protocol | page(View, ctx) | all |
| `webc_body_into` | unsafe body parsing | body(T) | all |
| `->arena` | reaching into a request | nothing | all |
| `db_error(` | surfacing a driver message | nothing: db_* already does | all |
| `res_error(500` | a hand-built driver error | fail(409, "...") | all |
| `_ref(` | indexing a vector by hand | for_each(item, vec) | all |
| `%.*s` | str internals in a format string | a Text field prints with %s | all |
| `parse_iso(` | a stamp in an unnamed unit (it is milliseconds) | parse_iso_ms() | all |

45 rules.
